name: OPAL
quality_metrics: WikiText2 token PPL | C4 PPL | ARC-Challenge accuracy | PIQA accuracy
performance_scope: generation token energy and accelerator/core hardware
physical_method: RTL except SRAM; Design Compiler synthesis; CACTI on-chip memory including leakage
dram_model: External DRAM command/state energy pipeline not established by §5.2; CACTI described for on-chip SRAM
validation: Numerical software tests; inspected method does not establish full post-layout chip calibration
pitfall: Do not equate '<1 average PPL increase' with <5% for every model or with zero error relative to BF16.
source_version: arXiv v3; header contains placeholders; venue independently verified

name: MoNDE
physical_method: NDP Design Compiler; commercial memory compiler for on-chip buffers; expert cycle model + Ramulator + measured profiling
dram_model: Micron DDR4-3200 power calculator, voltage-adjusted to LPDDR
area_boundary: Added NDP logic/buffer; GPU platform retained separately
validation: Measured host execution profiling plus simulated NDP expert execution
pitfall: A heterogeneous MoE system result is not a same-model dense ASIC result; DDR to LPDDR voltage scaling remains an approximation.

name: UniCAIM
quality_metrics: LongBench HotpotQA F1 | LongBench NarrativeQA F1
performance_scope: Attention circuit area/energy/delay/AEDP and separate pruning quality
physical_method: HSPICE, 45nm BSIM + Preisach FeFET, wire parasitics, 10-bit SAR ADC, 64 parallel sensing ADCs
dram_model: Circuit attention/cache evaluation; external DRAM whole-system accounting not established
area_boundary: FeFET attention circuits including modeled periphery
validation: Circuit simulation and application pruning algorithm tests are separate evidence
pitfall: AEDP gains are not full-LLM J/token gains; matching pruning ratios does not establish matching process/PVT.

name: MBA: Mega-Buffer Architecture Based on 1T1C IGZO eDRAM for Efficient LLM Inference
performance_scope: behavior-level graph simulation, whole-model latency/energy plus buffer ablations
physical_method: PE costs from NB-SMT45nm scaled with DeepScaleTool to7nm; modified FinCACTI eDRAM; SFU/NoC cited component models
dram_model: HBM1.5TB/s, fixed3.9pJ/bit; detailed command/state power pipeline not disclosed
area_boundary: Estimated accelerator total569.87mm2; not an established full-chip P&R result
validation: Referenced prior eDRAM testchip is distinct from the proposed MBA accelerator; end-to-end error calibration not disclosed
pitfall: A100 comparison measurement procedure is unclear; do not call it a measured GPU run. Buffer-management ablation differs from full GPU-vs-system gains.

name: Kelle
quality_metrics: WikiText2 PPL | PG19 PPL | ARC-Easy accuracy | PIQA accuracy | other QA/generation metrics
performance_scope: End-to-end edge accelerator inference and matched-area architecture ablations
physical_method: SystemVerilog DC45nm Nangate logic; Destiny65nm/105C SRAM/eDRAM; CACTI7 LPDDR4
dram_model: CACTI7 estimate for16GB LPDDR4 at64GB/s; external time/energy included
area_boundary: On-chip accelerator9.5mm2 reported separately from external memory
validation: Model quality tests, RTL synthesis and memory models; full P&R not established in inspected section
pitfall: The model combines45nm logic with65nm memory costs; published acceptance of a larger PPL change is not an acceptance criterion for our design.
source_version: author camera-ready PDF; arXiv2510.16040v1 used only as parallel text aid

name: AttAcc
models: LLaMA65B configuration | GPT3-175B configuration | MT-NLG530B configuration | OPT66B calibration workload
physical_method: Modified Ramulator; ASAP7 DC arithmetic; modified FinCACTI; DRAM die area scaling
dram_model: Prior HBM ACT/read energy; datapath length scaling; DRAM die logic area projected to1z process
area_boundary: PIM arithmetic/buffers and HBM overhead plus GPU-system configuration
validation: Performance calibrated against real DGX A100 OPT66B; not proof of energy-model calibration
pitfall: LLAMA and GPT3 use FP16; MT-NLG uses INT8. Same capacity/max-batch and B1 latency answer different questions.

name: NeuPIMs
models: GPT3-7B configuration | GPT3-13B configuration | GPT3-30B configuration | GPT3-175B configuration
performance_scope: Batched serving compute/memory timing; cited power table concerns memory
physical_method: ONNXim extension + PIM DRAMsim3; CACTI7 row-buffer area22nm
dram_model: Micron power model in DRAMsim3; all-bank compute power assumed4x RD; added row-buffer background
area_boundary: Main explicit new area estimate is dual row-buffer overhead; not a full P&R chip
validation: Architectural simulator + modeled new commands; power assumptions explicit
pitfall: 1.8x power and2.4x speed refer to inspected memory accounting, not calibrated whole-NPU system PPA.

name: CENT / PIM Is All You Need
performance_scope: CXL PIM system versus A100 GPU, latency/throughput/power/token-per-J
physical_method: Modified Ramulator2 and activity-based component system model
dram_model: PIM/DRAM activity cost accounting includes ACT/PRE and compute
area_boundary: PIM/CXL devices; GPU board power separately measured
validation: Functional trace basis; GPU nvidia-smi100ms power; simulation sampling option documented
pitfall: Maximum batch may differ by system. Report sampling stride if artifact interpolates rather than simulates every token.

name: Anda
quality_metrics: PPL with2048 sequence length | relative accuracy metric as defined by paper | BOP reduction
performance_scope: PE and accelerator FP-INT GEMM efficiency; not unrestricted full-LLM E2E
physical_method: 16nm Genus, synthesized-netlist VCD power, cycle-accurate simulator verified with functional simulations
validation: Functional simulator verification; not a stated independent silicon PPA calibration
pitfall: BOP reduction and a 'system-level' GEMM speedup are not automatically end-to-end request speedup.

name: LLMCompass
physical_method: Tile-level model with local compute/communication simulation and area cost models
dram_model: Configured bandwidth/capacity hierarchy; do not infer target-DRAM power model
area_boundary: Area-based cost model rather than a full synthesized chip
validation: v1 reports average operator latency error10.4%, LLM latency error4.1%; these are performance errors
pitfall: A calibrated timing framework does not by itself validate energy, stochastic-source behavior or our new modules.
source_version: preprint v1 figures; final venue verified by official code repository

name: Splitwise
performance_scope: TTFT/TBT/E2E p50/p90/p99 SLO, request throughput, cluster resources
physical_method: Measured A100/H100 profiles + discrete-event simulator + KV-transfer benchmark
dram_model: Measured platform performance/communication; not a newly synthesized DRAM PPA model
area_boundary: Cluster cost/power provisioning rather than ASIC core area
validation: Piecewise latency model MAPE<3% on80:20 split; >50k iterations end-to-end validation
pitfall: Provisioned power budget and actual J/output token must not be equated.

name: DS-CIM
quality_metrics: BoolQ acc | PIQA acc | HellaSwag acc | WinoGrande acc | ARC-e acc | ARC-c acc
performance_scope: Macro peak TOPS/W and TOPS/mm2; separate model quality
physical_method: Custom SNG/OR cells characterized;40nm DC + Innovus + Virtuoso post-layout
dram_model: No full LLM external DRAM timing/energy pipeline established
validation: Post-layout macro simulation; DS-CIM error-pattern injection into quantized MVM
pitfall: Do not bind T256 LLM quality to T64 peak efficiency; table scaling is40nm/1b input/1b weight, formula not fully disclosed.

name: ARTEMIS
models: Transformer-base | BERT-base | ALBERT-base | ViT-base | OPT-350 (paper label,350M)
quality_metrics: task accuracy for encoder/vision workloads | OPT-350 BLEU
performance_scope: In-DRAM mapping performance/energy and circuit overhead
physical_method: Python mapping simulator; LTSPICE tile latency; Genus digital periphery; CACTI-3D
dram_model: 22nm HBM-derived ACT and pre/post-GSA and I/O energy table
area_boundary: DRAM subarray modification and system model
validation: Circuit error integrated into model; not full7B fabricated LLM system
pitfall: BLEU17.79→17.49 is not a PPL change;128bit+sign stochastic representation differs from our FFN.

name: SCARLET
models: OPT family | Llama2 family | GPTNeo family
performance_scope: Photonic crossbar/module and accelerator estimates; phase latency
physical_method: Photonic/device/peripheral component models; HardFloat digital units; GF22FDX SRAM scaled to7nm
dram_model: HBM20pJ/bit;40ns same interposer/80ns cross interposer; CXL64GB/s
area_boundary: Hybrid photonic and digital chiplet components; not all objects share a CMOS node
validation: Approximate arithmetic quality simulation; read section does not establish device drift in full-model quality
pitfall: Next-token argmax accuracy cannot substitute for PPL, and the SRAM scaling is not whole-device process normalization.

name: Hybrid Systolic Array (HSA)
models: RetNet-1.3B hardware main workload | RetNet-3B quality | Llama2-7B quality | Llama3.x quality
quality_metrics: WikiText2 PPL | GSM8K generative accuracy for Instruct Llama
performance_scope: RetNet end-to-end prefill/decode; token-related summary metrics count input+output
area_boundary: Accelerator28nm post-layout; external memory energy separately included where marked
validation: Post-layout hardware simulation; additional model numerical tests
pitfall: Hardware RetNet1.3B and Llama quality are distinct cases; summary tokens include prompts.

name: SANTA / S²ANTA
performance_scope: Attention kernel and full decode measured separately; no ASIC PPA
dram_model: Actual GPU cache/memory behavior; not a target-ASIC DRAM estimator
validation: GPU timing and numerical tasks; do not assign GPU runtime simulation to p-bit hardware
pitfall: ms/output token divides by B×G; decode speedup is not full-request speedup.
